clusters.rationale: Strong selected-request activity and above-average vulnerability, without the distinctive acute filing or demolition concentration of the corresponding event profiles.

Every baseline member has a mapped recent filing; mean recent filings are about 11.7 per 100 units versus at most 2.4 in other profiles, with a strongly positive rate change and elevated vulnerability.
Strong nearby opening exposure with some ownership concentration; amenity change is a contextual smoke signal, not direct evidence of displacement.
Below-average measured pressure across the six signal indices; vulnerability remains present and is not uniformly low.
Every baseline member has a mapped recent residential demolition permit; the demolition index is the dominant defining feature. Permits are proxies, not confirmed displacement.
Strong ownership concentration and vulnerability; recent mean eviction rate remains far below the eviction-concentrated profile.
